Service controls: both topologies x eight conditions x three replicates x field/owner_guard/atomic_guard = 144 independent process runs.

primary.definitions: All sensitivity contrasts concern this new protocol; no pooling with v03. Certified endpoints include authoritative correctness plus the stated evidence contract.

preservation.explanation: Only the previously authorized continuing budget ledger changed; all historical execution sources, raw traces and manuscripts remain unchanged.

caveats: No human independent review or public repository release performed.
New configurations include reused/isomorphic constraint shapes; not four new independent structural families.
RAC is a matched-handler integration only, not a complete published benchmark reproduction.
Typed interface is an exploratory fixed subset, not a replacement for the original cohort.
Offline no-op partial attainment can reflect an external writer, not agent progress.
Raw late-writer claims are evaluated at the terminal acceptance boundary; they need not have been false at the last public observation.
